basic_info.headline: Senior Software Engineer at LinkedIn
basic_info.about:
• Designed and developed durable, scalable and secure software solutions (Web and Desktop applications) using numerous approaches and methodologies including SOA, OOP, AOP, Distributed architectures, RMDBS, Federated security and more. 
• Extensive experience engaging and eliciting business requirements from various stakeholders to produce successful software solutions. 
• Proficiency in developing multi-threading and asynchronous software solutions to improve performance and user experience. 
• Proficiency in numerous testing approaches such as Unit and Integration testing, Performance testing, Test-Driven Development. 
• Strong understanding and practical experience applying Design Patterns as well as using Dependency Injection frameworks. 
• Experience working in all phases of the Application Lifecycle. 
• Experience with Agile software development. 
• Good attitude and communication skills. 
• Continually seeking opportunities to grow and innovate.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description:
Continued duties and responsibilites from Lynda.com and playing major role in effort to overhaul the usability/user-experience for the Lynda.com web site as well as being the primary engineer tasked with improving performance of the homepage and other areas of the site. Accomplishments include:
• Lowering page times from 4+ seconds to less than a second for the 50% percentile of site visitors and 14 seconds to 4 seconds for the 90% percentile of site visitors.
• Utilized tools such as SQL Query Analyzer, SQL Profiler, JetBrains dotTrace and dotMemory for the purpose of analyzing and improving site performance.
• Developed numerous improvements to Enterprise Reporting system including overall performance as well as diagnosing and implementing fix for progress tracking features.
• Designed and implemented caching layer for systems to provide dual-support for multiple caching providers (e.g. Memcached, Couchbase)

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description:
• Engaging and eliciting business requirements from various stakeholders.
• Designing and implementing back-end solutions.
• Collaborating with teams to plan and organize paths towards achieving our objectives.
• Successful in built back-end notes system for allowing users to take personal notes to assist in the learning process while watching course videos.
   - This also included giving users a number of options for exporting this information into a number of formats including: text, DOCX, PDF, Evernote (integrating with their API using SSO), and Google Docs.
• Participated in building an assessments system that would provide feeback to users to help them gauge their understanding of topics they are actively learning.
   - This included building an administration system that would support the creation of assessments and their question including importing assessment data from an external source such as an Excel or Google Docs spreadsheet.

experience.title: Programmer, Software Architect
experience.description:
Responsibilities:
• Eliciting business requirements from various stakeholders and organizing these into requirements documentation and storyboards.
• Assisting in organizing and estimating completion of requirements into a product plan, iteration plans, and tasks.
• Leading and mentoring programming team. e.g. application design concepts, standards, and best practices. 

Achievements:
• Architected a metadata-driven search engine. This feature included the ability to allow the end user to specify columns, perform complex filtering, and group and sort data.  This solution also provided the ability to save user-defined searches and allow the users to manage a library of their searches.
• Introduced Aspect-Oriented Programming using PostSharp for the purpose of handling cross-cutting concerns in a performant way across our applications.  I designed a number of Aspects to handle validation, caching, automated change tracking, and auditing.  This approach allowed us to separate a large chunk of infrastructure code away from our business logic and to improve developer productivity and the maintainability of our applications.
• Designed and successfully implemented a solution to integrate RSA Adaptive Authentication into a login portal application.  Due to budgetary constraints, this was accomplished without using RSA’s implementation support team which saved the company from having to spend over $50,000 to purchase this service.
• Diagnosed and removed several bottlenecks from a critical, under-performing feature within the company’s Multiple Real Estate Listing System Web application.  This feature was not performing in accordance with an SLA established with an important customer.
